title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the sample clip to a graphics frame: eight of its own (a soft zoom-blur push, a blur dissolve, a white dip, a whip pan, a light-leak wipe, the colour burst, tall panels dropping in, a card opening over the blurred shot) two calm ones from the shared set in the theme's colours, and eight fast hits for edits that change something every second (a punch-in, whips the other way and downwards, a streak smear, a three-tone impact frame, a shutter blink, a card landing from below, panels slipping apart). Keep them short (0.25–0.45 s; the hits 0.15–0.3 s): cuts in this style are soft and fast.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "soft_zoom", "seconds": 0.4}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start or end of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "panel_drop", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.4}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: soft zoom
items.description: A short, soft zoom-blur push through the shot into the next; no flash. The theme default.

items.name: blur dissolve
items.description: The shot slips out of focus, becomes the next while both are a blur, and comes back sharp.

items.name: white dip
items.description: A soft dip to white: highlights bloom, the picture washes out, the next comes down out of the white.

items.name: whip pan
items.description: A whip pan: the camera snaps sideways off one shot and lands on the next, both smeared along the move.

items.name: leak wipe
items.description: A soft-edged wipe travelling behind a warm light leak, sun yellow melting to poppy, with a cool trail.

items.name: colour burst
items.description: The loud one: the picture streaks outward with its channels split and its colours pushed to saturated red, blue and yellow. Once a video.

items.name: panel drop
items.description: The next shot arrives as five tall panels of unequal width sliding in from above and below at their own pace.

items.name: card open
items.description: The frame device: the shot blurs, grows and dims, and the next opens over it as a clean card that widens to the whole picture.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: Shared engine, in the theme’s colours: the picture folds away as tall panels.

items.name: warp wipe
items.description: Shared engine, in the theme’s colours: a soft wipe that bends the picture as it passes.

items.name: punch zoom
items.description: A hard punch-in: the shot is driven through a short, strong zoom blur and the next lands slightly over-scaled and settles. No flash. 0.2–0.3 s.

items.name: whip back
items.description: The whip pan in the opposite direction, so two whips in a row answer each other.

items.name: whip down
items.description: A vertical whip: the camera snaps down off one shot and lands on the next.

items.name: speed smear
items.description: Speed-ramp feel: a seam runs across dragging every row into one long streak, and the next shot resolves out of its own streaks.

items.name: flash frame
items.description: An impact frame: for an instant the picture is three tones — ink blacks, poppy mids, white highlights — then it is the next shot. 0.15–0.25 s; a few times a video at most.

items.name: shutter blink
items.description: A camera shutter: two soft-edged near-black blades close from top and bottom; the next shot is there when they open.

items.name: card slam
items.description: The inverse of card open: the next shot comes up from below as a clean card larger than the frame and lands exactly on it, over the shot before dimmed and blurred.

items.name: split shift
items.description: The theme’s three tall panels slip off vertically in alternate directions, smeared by their speed, with the next shot underneath.
